title: Canonical finite-root-line pullback, unit and class arrows
statement: For a commutative ring $A$ with $mA=0$, use the existing finite etale Tate line $L_T$ [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], placed in degree zero in $D^+$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For $f:X\to Y$ with $m>0$ invertible on both schemes, define the normalized pullback $f^{-1}L_Y\cong L_X$ by the canonical finite-twist pure-tensor map, its derived adjunction unit $L_Y\to Rf_*L_X$, and its canonical global pullback $R\Gamma(Y,L_Y)\to R\Gamma(X,L_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Forgetting scalars defines the corresponding ordinary cohomology pullback. For a primitive root $\zeta$ in a field $k$ and a $k$-scheme $T$, the constant class is $\zeta\otimes a$; the ordinary Kummer class of a unit $w$ is the ordinary Kummer boundary followed by $z\mapsto z\otimes1_A$ [def-sc-kummer-sequence]. The auxiliary annihilator, positivity and exponent-unit terms are the canonical witnesses from the algebra structure, primality and base-field structure map. These are exactly the already published plain definitions in RelativeKummerStrictLocalInvariance, with no invocation of its invariance theorem.

def relativeKummerLinePullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsUnit (m : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hX : IsUnit (m : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        (relativeKummerLinePlus A m hA Y) ≅ relativeKummerLinePlus A m hA X
